selection: Purposive exploratory batch; cannot estimate prevalence.

cases.title: Seattle Pioneer Square areaways

claims.locator: Main-text paragraphs defining areaways and describing street raising
claims.statement: SDOT reports engineered street raising after the 1889 fire and retaining walls beneath roadways.

cases.surviving_documents: Modern SDOT account; original grading plans uncollected.
cases.source_interpretation: Deliberate grade raising created the lower level.
cases.investigation_inference: An identified engineering alternative merits checking against original records before attributing burial to a natural event.
competing_explanations: Local natural deposition or subsidence, if independently evidenced
cases.counterevidence: The below-ground level alone does not discriminate its cause; an engineered mechanism is documented.
cases.next_test: Retrieve block-specific grading plans and dated construction records; compare wall geometry and fill logs.

chronology.dated_object: Street raising as reported in a modern account

cases.dependence: Same city as C002, but a different project; do not merge dates or count city-level narratives as independent global observations.

cases.title: Woodward and Edison incandescent-lamp patent comparison
cases.place: United States patent; Menlo Park attribution

claims.locator: PDF pages 2-3: heading, opening, antecedent discussion and claims
claims.statement: The scan identifies an 1879 application and an 1880 patent for an improvement; it discusses earlier incandescent lamps.
Metadata gives filing 4 November 1879 and publication 27 January 1880.

claims.locator: PDF page 2 heading and specification; page 3 claim
claims.statement: Woodward filed January 4, 1875 and received patent 181,613 on August 29, 1876; it describes carbon in a vessel filled with rarefied nonreactive gas.

cases.physical_evidence: Woodward patent pages 1-3 and Edison specification pages 2-3 visually inspected; no original lamp tested.
cases.surviving_documents: Two patent scans; Woodward assignment heading; notebooks and full transfer instruments unreviewed.
cases.investigation_inference: A documented carbon-lamp antecedent predates Edison. Technical similarities and differences require comparison; priority of disclosure alone does not prove copying, ownership transfer or ancient recovery.
competing_explanations: Recovery from a demonstrably earlier artifact
cases.counterevidence: Woodward predates Edison for a disclosed carbon-lamp arrangement. Edison claims more specific filament/vacuum combinations. Neither patent establishes recovery from a lost civilization or sole invention of all electric lighting.
cases.next_test: Retrieve original transfer instruments and dated laboratory records; compare other antecedents and measured lamp performance with each claimed technical improvement.

chronology.reported: Woodward: filing 1875-01-04, grant 1876-08-29; Edison: filing 1879-11-04, publication 1880-01-27

cases.dependence: Each scan and its OCR are one record. Two patents document distinct disclosures but do not establish a transmission chain between them.

cases.title: Yukon mammoth and horse sedimentary DNA

claims.statement: Authors report mammoth and horse DNA beyond local dated macrofossils, while discussing reworking and requesting further confirmation.
